Definition: Epher, the name of an Arabian and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Epher = "a calf"; 1) the 2nd son of Midian; 2) a son of Ezra, among the descendants of Judah; 3) one of the heads of the families of Manasseh on the east of the Jordan
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
